name: homologyIsoPos
statement: ℕ) [NeZero n] (m : ℤ) (hm : m = n) [h.cochainComplex.HasHomology m] [L.HasHomology n] : h.cochainComplex.homology m ≅ L.homology n

name: homologyIsoNeg
statement: ℕ) [NeZero n] (m : ℤ) (hm : m = -(n + 1 : ℕ)) [h.cochainComplex.HasHomology m] [K.HasHomology n] : h.cochainComplex.homology m ≅ K.homology n
